purpose: Star 9 shell sprint dependency and license decisions
plan9_rule: Shell and VM features operate through Star 9 namespaces, files, fds, tasks, terminals, device files, and 9P exports. Host capabilities may implement providers, but must not become privileged side APIs.

dependencies.name: reedline
dependencies.role: native interactive line editing for star9 shell
dependencies.notes: Used only for native CLI input; command behavior remains in star9-shell.

dependencies.name: rcshell
dependencies.notes: GPL dependency is not accepted for Star 9 shell implementation.

dependencies.name: rs9p
dependencies.role: possible native Linux v9fs compatibility adapter
dependencies.notes: Does not replace Star 9's browser-aware Rust 9P stack.

dependencies.name: unpfs
dependencies.notes: Useful as a reference or fixture, not a Star 9 runtime dependency.

shell_scope.execution_boundary: ShellHost routes commands through Star 9 runtime namespaces, task files, fd files, device files, and typed runtime requests.
